groups.name: support
groups.label: Support
groups.about: what the claim rests on: evidence, proof, citation, argument or judgement

groups.name: plan
groups.label: Plan
groups.about: whether the test was planned before it was run, and how the plan was anchored

groups.name: checkable
groups.label: Checkable
groups.about: whether a reader can obtain what is needed to check the claim

groups.name: context
groups.label: Context
groups.about: where the claim holds, what earlier work it relates to, and which recorded results its numbers come from

groups.name: open
groups.label: Open problems
groups.about: limitations and assumptions that are still open

support_kind.fix: Support the claim with evidence the claimset records, citing the result entries or table rows it reports, or have its proof checked.

exploratory_inference.text: {type} claim tested without a plan recorded beforehand{record}
exploratory_inference.fix: Test it again under a lab-record plan or a registration, or publish the lab record that shows every run.

exploratory_principal.text: A principal claim reported without a plan recorded beforehand{record}
exploratory_principal.fix: Plan the measurement in the lab record or a registration before running it, or publish the lab record that shows every run.

plan_anchor.fix: Anchor plans with the platform, a timestamp authority (RFC 3161) or a registry.

plan_deviations.text: The test deviated from its plan
plan_deviations.fix: Each deviation is a limitation: say how it bears on the result.

plan_flags.text: The lab record flags the test: {flags}
plan_flags.fix: Rerun the test as planned, or explain the flag in a limitation.

verifiability.fix: Make the data, code and models the claim rests on available, or state why they cannot be.

verifiability_flags.fix: Publish what each flag says is missing.

no_scope.text: No scope: where the claim holds is not stated
no_scope.fix: Give the claim a scope: population, setting, period, data, conditions, exclusions.

no_prior_work.text: A principal claim related to no earlier work
no_prior_work.fix: Relate the claim to the earlier work it extends, addresses or departs from.

numbers_without_results.text: Numbers in the statement match no recorded result
numbers_without_results.fix: Record each number as a result or table cell of the evidence the claim cites, and list it in the support's results; or correct the number.

limitation.fix: Mitigate it with evidence, or narrow the claim's scope so that it no longer applies.

no_limitation.text: A principal claim that declares no limitation
no_limitation.fix: Declare what could bias, reverse or limit the claim within its scope, each as a limitation that affects it.

unchecked_assumption.fix: Test the assumption, or analyse how sensitive the claim is to it.
